title: fix(console): a refused single sign-on names its cause, SSO with no email asks for one, and checkboxes stop drawing as circles
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB7Ve7hc1cXfVqifkJUq26e6)_

Part of #32087 (items 1, 2, 3 and 6; items 4 and 5 stay with their owner).

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：SSO 登录被拒时，登录页按原因给出一句终端用户能照做的话（技术原因收进「技术详情」折叠里）；邮箱为空就点「使用 SSO 登录」会先提示填写工作邮箱、不再发请求；控制台里的复选框不再被主题画成圆形（「编辑登录选项」的两个独立开关因此不再像单选）。
- 为什么改：Enterprise 客户 Okta 实测里，每种拒绝都显示「登录链接已过期」并附上给管理员看的原文，空邮箱直接露出服务端字段报错，两个开关看起来只能二选一。
- 风险与回滚：只动登录页文案、LoginForm 的前置校验和控制台样式表中一条复选框规则，无服务端、无元数据变更，回滚即 revert 本 PR；SAML 的 IdP 发起登录被拒时服务端把错误带到站点根 `/`、根跳转丢掉参数，登录页收不到信号，本 PR 未处理，待席位另立服务端子卡。
- 先看：`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/ssoCallbackRefusal.ts`（原因码到文案的映射）、`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx`（横幅与折叠）、`ui/apps/console/src/index.css`（复选框圆角那一条）。
- 两分钟验证：打开 `/_console/login?error=SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED`，应看到「Your account isn't set up for this system yet. Ask your administrator to invite you.」，展开 Technical details 才看到原因码。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

1. **"Sign in with SSO" with an empty email field** (`@object-ui/auth` `LoginForm`). `handleSso` now refuses an empty or whitespace-only field before any request, with the new optional label `LoginFormLabels.ssoEmailRequiredText` (English default "Enter your work email to sign in with SSO."). The same label replaces the untranslated sentence a phone-shaped identifier used to get in that path. Both login pages pass it from `auth.login.ssoEmailRequiredText`, so the every-member labels pin keeps holding both.
2. **A refused single sign-on names its own cause** (console `LoginPage`). The banner used to print `auth.login.errors.oauthCallbackFailed` ("…the sign-in link expired or was already used. Please try again.") plus the raw cause in parentheses for every refusal. A new module, `ssoCallbackRefusal.ts`, maps the `error` code the server lands with to an end-user sentence:

   | `error` code (measured, see Verification) | Sentence key |
   |:---|:---|
   | `SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED` | `auth.login.errors.ssoAccountNotInvited` |
   | `account_not_linked` | `auth.login.errors.ssoAccountNotLinked` |
   | `saml_error`, `invalid_saml_response` | `auth.login.errors.ssoResponseRejected` |
   | `state_not_found` | `auth.login.errors.ssoStartFromLoginPage` |
   | anything else | `auth.login.errors.oauthCallbackFailed` (unchanged) |

   The code and `error_description` (written for administrators, e.g. the audience gate's "…turn on just-in-time provisioning (allowJit)…") leave the sentence and sit behind a "Technical details" `details` toggle under the banner, so the person can open it and pass it on. `DefaultLoginPage` in `@object-ui/app-shell` reads no `?error=` and draws no callback banner (measured: no `error` read in that file), so the mapping has one reader and lives beside it.
3. **IdP-initiated sign-in refused.** For OIDC, a callback with a code and no `state` (an IdP-initiated sign-in the provider does not allow) lands on the login page as `?error=state_not_found`; that code now reads "Sign-in has to start from this system's login page. Enter your work email here and choose Sign in with SSO." For SAML, see the deviation under Acceptance notes: the server's signal never reaches the login page, so no UI change was made for it.
4. **Checkboxes no longer draw as circles** (console stylesheet). The Radix checkbox is 16px and draws `rounded-sm`, i.e. `var(--radius-sm)`. The console's theme layer sets `--radius: 0.875rem`, so `--radius-sm` was 10px, more than half the box: every checkbox in the console rendered as a circle, the two independent toggles of "Edit Sign-In Options" (Allow IdP-Initiated Sign-In, Allow JIT) included. `apps/console/src/index.css` now sets `--radius-sm: 0.25rem` on `[role="checkbox"]` only. The dialog itself already drew both as `role="checkbox"`; the defect was the corner, measured live at 10px before and 4px after. No `packages/**` metadata moves.
5. **`@object-ui/i18n`:** `auth.login.ssoEmailRequiredText` and `auth.login.errors.ssoAccountNotInvited` / `ssoAccountNotLinked` / `ssoResponseRejected` / `ssoStartFromLoginPage` / `ssoTechnicalDetails` in all 11 packs.

Changeset: `.changeset/32087-sso-login-refusal-sentences.md`, patch for `@object-ui/auth`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/console` (`@object-ui/app-shell` is private).

## Tests

- `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/LoginForm.test.tsx`, new describe "\"Sign in with SSO\" with no email": empty field and whitespace-only field show the sentence and send no request; the SSO-only form's empty submit does the same; a host label replaces the default; CONTROL: with an email the request to `/api/v1/auth/sign-in/sso` goes out.
- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/LoginPage.error-banner.test.tsx`: the two existing cases now assert the cause in the details toggle and out of the alert; new describe "a refused single sign-on names its own cause": each of the five codes shows its own sentence, never the generic one, with neither the code nor the description inside the alert and both in the toggle; CONTROL: an unknown code (`invalid_provider`) and a code named like an `Object.prototype` member keep the generic sentence.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.test.tsx`, new describe "two boolean params are independent controls": two checkboxes and no radio; turning one on leaves the other; both on resolve `{ allowIdpInitiated: true, allowJit: true }`.
- `ui/apps/console/src/index-css-scan-excludes-tests.test.ts`, new describe "a checkbox is not drawn round": compiles the real console stylesheet; `.rounded-sm` reads `var(--radius-sm)` and the checkbox rule sets `--radius-sm` below 8px.

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, each restored with git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- Item 2: `message={ssoCallbackRefusalMessage(t, callbackError.code)}` replaced by the old generic sentence plus cause: `LoginPage.error-banner.test.tsx` 9 failed / 1 passed (every item-2 pin and both controls red; the plain-page case stays green). Restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Item 1: `if (!identifier || looksLikePhoneIdentifier(identifier)) {` back to `if (looksLikePhoneIdentifier(identifier)) {`: `LoginForm.test.tsx` 4 failed / 27 passed (the four empty-field pins red, the CONTROL green). Restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Item 6: deleted `  --radius-sm: 0.25rem;` from `index.css`: the stylesheet pin 1 failed / 3 passed. Restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.

The console and auth suites import `@object-ui/*` from source (vitest aliases), so no dist rebuild sits between the mutation and the run.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Deviation (item 3, SAML): the server sends no signal the login page can read.** Measured through plugin-auth's real SAML ACS pipeline (the IdP played with `samlify` as in `sso-saml-refusal-landing.test.ts`): an unsolicited Response with `allowIdpInitiated` off answers `302 http://localhost:3000/?error=unsolicited_response&error_description=IdP-initiated+SSO+not+allowed`. It lands on the site root because an IdP-initiated response has no relay state, and the provider's stored `callbackUrl` is the ACS URL itself, which the vendor's redirect safety rule skips, so it falls back to the app origin. On a live dev boot, `GET /?error=unsolicited_response&…` answers `302 location: /_console/` (the root redirect in `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts`, `app.get('/', …redirect(CONSOLE_PATH + '/'))`), which drops the query. Per the order, no server code changed here; the seat files a `domain:server` child (either land the IdP-initiated refusal on the login page as the other SAML refusals are, or keep the query through the root redirect). The UI side is then one row in `ssoCallbackRefusal.ts` for `unsolicited_response`.
- `state_not_found` is also what a callback URL opened again later answers; the "start from this system's login page" sentence reads right for both.
- Ruling grep (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`) over every touched file: hits only in regions this diff does not touch (the dev-admin password note in `LoginPage.tsx`; the `filterVisibleParams` ruling notes in `ActionParamDialog.test.tsx`; unrelated locale-file comments). None governs the touched lines.
- No `packages/spec/**` change; ADR-0060 ratchet and `check:spec-symbols` green (Verification).
- Serial with #32050 (same seat): this diff keeps to the callback banner block, the labels block and new files; the owner probe and `invalidCredentialsNoMail` regions are untouched.

## Verification

Screenshots (live dev boot of `main` + this branch: backend `pnpm dev -- --fresh` with `OS_SSO_ENABLED=true` and one SAML provider registered through `/api/v1/auth/admin/sso/register-saml`; console Vite with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`) are in the project folder `ui-orders/32087-shots/`:

- `01-empty-email-sso.png`: alert "Enter your work email to sign in with SSO.", zero `/sign-in/sso` requests; CONTROL with `mia@acme.com` sent `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/sso`.
- `02-self-registration-closed.png` (toggle open), `03-account-not-linked.png`, `04-saml-error.png`, `05-state-not-found.png`, `06-unknown-code-generic.png` (toggle open): each URL is the measured landing query.
- `07-zh-self-registration-closed.png`, `08-zh-empty-email-sso.png`: zh-CN.
- `09-edit-sign-in-options-before.png` (index.css restored from `origin/main`: both checkboxes 16x16, computed `border-radius` 10px, drawn round) and `09-edit-sign-in-options-after.png` (4px).

Through plugin-auth's real SAML ACS (scratch test built on `sso-saml-refusal-landing.test.ts`'s harness, console sign-in shape `callbackURL: '/_console/home'`, no `errorCallbackURL`):

```
SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED  302 http://localhost:3000/_console/login?error=SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED&error_description=This+single+sign-on+provider+does+not+create+accounts+for+people+who+were+not+invited+%28audience+posture+invite_only%29.+…
account_not_linked        302 http://localhost:3000/_console/login?error=account_not_linked
tampered assertion        302 http://localhost:3000/_console/login?error=saml_error&error_description=Invalid+SAML+response
IdP-initiated, toggle off 302 http://localhost:3000/?error=unsolicited_response&error_description=IdP-initiated+SSO+not+allowed
OIDC callback, no state   302 http://localhost:3000/_console/login?error=state_not_found
```

```
GET /?error=unsolicited_response&…            302 location: /_console/
GET /api/v1/auth/sso/callback/acme-okta?code=abc   302 location: http://localhost:38771/_console/login?error=state_not_found
POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/sso {"email":""}     {"message":"email, organizationSlug, domain or providerId is required"}
```
